analysis.title: U.S. Analyst Focus List Current Snapshot (11-NOV-26)
key_insights: JPM's monthly Analyst Focus List is a full refresh each month. Analysts pick top ideas by strategy (growth, income, value, short). It is not a model portfolio, and prior editions should not be relied on.
The 11-NOV-26 snapshot lists 63 Overweight or Neutral names across CapGoods/Ind, Consumer, Energy, Financials, Healthcare, Materials, Media & Telecom and Technology. All price targets end Dec-27.

Last four weeks' additions: Sterling Infrastructure (STRL, 11/10, PT $585), Meta Platforms (META, 11/9, PT $940), Howmet Aerospace (HWM, 11/2, PT $285), Quebecor (QBR/B CN, 11/2), Moody's (MCO, 11/2, PT $555), Palantir (PLTR, 10/29, PT $262), Dollar General (DG, 10/26, PT $178), Tango Therapeutics (TNGX, 10/26), Rhythm Pharmaceuticals (RYTM, 10/15).

Last four weeks' removals: Alphabet (GOOGL and GOOG, 11/9, Doug Anmuth, PT $375), DraftKings (DKNG, 11/9, Neutral, add price $33.16 vs removal price $18.51), Boeing (BA, 11/2), Xenon Pharmaceuticals (XENE, 11/2), T-Mobile US (TMUS, 11/2), First Industrial Realty (FR, 10/30), Boston Scientific (BSX, 10/28, add price $52.80 vs removal $42.43), S&P Global (SPGI, 10/28), Dollar Tree (DLTR, 10/26), Fervo (FRVO, 10/19, add price $37.22 vs removal $9.68).
Doug Anmuth swapped Alphabet out and Meta in on 11/9 (META add price $610.15, PT $940, 46.56% upside). Amazon (AMZN, PT $365) stays on the list.

Largest absolute gains since add: Eli Lilly (LLY) +1030.46% since 3/12/19, Carvana (CVNA) +265.10%, Revolution Medicines (RVMD) +225.35%, SharkNinja (SN) +153.64%, Guidewire (GWRE) +155.98%, Broadcom (AVGO) +171.52%, Caterpillar (CAT) +133.15%, United Airlines (UAL) +122.35%, TransUnion (TRU) +121.11%.

Largest losers since add: Olema Oncology (OLMA) -73.21%, McCormick (MKC) -32.34%, Liberty Energy (LBRT) -31.45%, Celsius (CELH) -29.52%, AGCO -23.54%, C.H. Robinson (CHRW) -19.27%, Tyler Technologies (TYL) -14.61%, Palantir (PLTR) -14.22% in under two weeks.

Highest upside to JPM price target: Olema (OLMA) 532.74%, Liberty Energy (LBRT) 148.20%, Sterling Infrastructure (STRL) 102.03%, Amer Sports (AS) 100.88%, ORIC 191.81%, Cogent (COGT) 92.79%, Tango (TNGX) 93.42%, Cytokinetics (CYTK) 83.34%.
Names at or past target: Victoria's Secret (VSXY) price $110.75 vs PT $110 (-0.68% upside), Tenable (TENB) $41.96 vs PT $41 (-2.29%), Q2 Holdings (QTWO) 0.89% upside, Macerich (MAC) 1.48% upside.
Mega-cap Walmart (WMT, market cap $1,001.6bn) has a $145 PT and 15.49% upside. Amazon, Meta, Eli Lilly and Broadcom each carry market caps above $1.6 trillion.
Only Neutral rating on the current list is Gaming and Leisure Properties (GLPI, Income, PT $46). Annaly (NLY) is the other Income idea, rated Overweight.
The report lists no short ideas in the current snapshot. Short ideas are published separately in 'Top Short Ideas'.

Several data points look inconsistent in the source and should be treated with care: Curbline Properties market cap shows $3,615.5bn, and KLA Corporation relative return shows -184.56% against a +6.44% total return. Quebecor's PT shows C$85.00 in the main table and C$80.00 in the additions table.
